title: Kissed Spicy French Vialone Nano Gratin
description: A spicy, cheese-pull, nostalgic French dish featuring vialone nano, flambe, and low-fat-friendly ingredients, reminiscent of Normandy cuisine. This gratin is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the vialone nano rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the calvados, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the calvados mixture over the rice and stir to combine.
Transfer the rice mixture to a baking dish and top with gruyere cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and flambe the top with a kitchen torch, if desired.
